notes: The frozen universal C2 claim is false. If gamma0 is the intended smooth counterclockwise single traversal, its periodic double traversal gamma2(t)=gamma0(2*t mod 2*pi) has the same image, satisfies both level-set equations and closedness, and has positive signed-area integral, hence satisfies apm_t00a05_IsC2. Reparameterization doubles both the signed-area integral and the omega line integral, so its period is -4*pi rather than -2*pi. The predicate needs injectivity, embedding, or winding number one; no bridge was added.
